tierPurchase: MainExchangeLayer::onHttpRequestExchange 0x7deebc..0x7deef6: type9; getSpecialTagData2(400+special), increment by one, cap8, setSpecialTagData2.
tierEligibility: MainExchangeLayer::refreshView 0x7e0280..0x7e02d2: type9; current stage must equal num-1; reject current stage>7.
tierEffects: Each series uses exchange.special as its group and exchange.num as stage. Per-stage effect is taken from original exchange.desc; displayed cumulative effect is stage times the per-stage increment. Displayed effect excludes base capacity/speed.
costs: point is the price of this stage; totalPoints sums configured prices through that stage. Series have 8/8/8/7/7/2 configured stages; do not invent missing stages based on native cap8.
